title: Trips
intro: Manage departures, assigned buses and fares. Times are shown in Cairo time.
timeHint: All dates and times use Cairo time. Repeated or skipped daylight-saving times are rejected.
hasBookings: Trips with reservations cannot be edited. Use the authorized cancellation flow when needed.
inUse: This trip is referenced and cannot be deleted.
missingOption: A selected route or bus no longer exists. Refresh the list.
alreadyCancelled: This trip was cancelled and cannot be changed.
conflict: The bus has a conflicting departure. Refresh and choose another time or bus.
inactive: Choose an active route and bus.
unresolved: Payments need reconciliation before this trip can be cancelled.
cancelHint: Cancel this departure and prepare full refunds for confirmed bookings. Refunds must be issued separately by a super admin.
cancelledNotice: Trip cancelled. Review the full refund obligations.
deleteHint: Delete this unused trip? Trips linked to bookings cannot be deleted.
readFailedHint: Refresh to load the list and all route/bus choices.
staleHint: The displayed records may be out of date. Refresh before making changes.
emptyHint: Change the filters or add a departure with an active route and bus.
batchHint: Choose up to 90 days and review every generated departure before creating trips.
readyToCreate: Preview is ready. Schedule conflicts will be checked again when creating trips.
conflictsFound: Resolve all schedule conflicts before creating this batch.
invalidTime: A Cairo departure time is repeated or skipped by a daylight-saving change. Choose another time.
noDepartures: No departures match the selected days and date range.
arrivalHint: Choose a departure date, time and duration to see the arrival.
